The Lo-Ellen program

Inside the
EDIT Lab.

Saffron is one of Lo-Ellen’s FIRST Tech Challenge teams. The shared EDIT Lab gives students access to CAD, 3D printing, CNC machining, and tools for building robots.

The program works to expand STEM education and participation, and develop skilled trades in Northern Ontario.

Explore the Lo-Ellen program
The details

Sponsorship
questions.

Something else on your mind?
team@22310.ca

Can we help without a cash donation?

Yes. The sponsorship package includes services, materials, and mentorship. Tell us what you can offer and we can discuss where it fits.

Where are the sponsorship levels?

The Lo-Ellen sponsorship package contains the current options and recognition. We’ll confirm the details with you before you commit.

Does this support Saffron or all of Lo-Ellen?

The linked package is for the Lo-Ellen Robotics program. If you want to discuss support specifically for Saffron, include that in your message so we can clarify the arrangement with you.

What should we include in our first message?

Your business or name, the kind of support you’re considering, and a good way to reach you. You don’t need a finished proposal.
